camel_example: aliyun ada CreateTransitUploadPolicy --region cn-hangzhou --FileShowName 'code-review.zip' --Network public --PathPrefix 'skill-bundle' --ExpireMs 604800000 --version 2026-07-01 --method POST --force
description_en: Generates a credential for direct file upload. The caller can use the returned upload policy to upload a file directly to object storage
description_zh: 生成文件直传凭证。调用方可以使用返回的上传策略将文件直接上传到对象存储
name: CreateTransitUploadPolicy

parameters.help_en: The path prefix used for object key isolation. This prefix has no Artifact business directory semantics. Default value: `default`
parameters.help_zh: 用于对象 key 隔离的路径前缀，无 Artifact 业务目录语义。默认值为 `default`
parameters.name: path_prefix

parameters.help_en: The validity period of the upload policy and the Transit record, in milliseconds. Valid values: 1000 to 604800000. The value is rounded down to the nearest whole second. If `ExpireMs` is omitted or a `null` placeholder is passed through the gateway's canonical field, the default validity period is `604800000` milliseconds (7 days)
parameters.help_zh: 上传策略及 Transit 记录的有效时长，单位为毫秒。范围为 1000～604800000，按整秒向下取整。省略 `ExpireMs` 或由网关传入规范字段的 `null` 占位时，默认有效时长为 `604800000` 毫秒（7 天）
parameters.name: expire_ms

parameters.help_en: The display name of the file. The value must be 1 to 512 characters in length. The object key is generated by the server and is not guaranteed to contain the original file name
parameters.help_zh: 文件显示名，长度为 1～512 个字符。对象 key 由服务端生成，不保证包含原始文件名
parameters.name: file_show_name

parameters.help_en: The network type of the upload address. Valid values: `public` and `internal`. Default value: `public`
parameters.help_zh: 上传地址的网络类型。可选值为 `public` 和 `internal`，默认值为 `public`
parameters.name: network

FilePath.description_en: The object storage key, which is also the `key` field in the PostObject form
FilePath.description_zh: 对象存储 key，也是 PostObject 表单的 `key`

PolicyInfo.description_en: The upload policy object. For the complete list of subfields, see the following table
PolicyInfo.description_zh: 上传策略对象；完整子字段见下表

AccessId.description_en: The `OSSAccessKeyId` field in the PostObject form. Protect this value together with the entire `PolicyInfo`
AccessId.description_zh: PostObject 表单的 `OSSAccessKeyId`。应与整个 `PolicyInfo` 一并妥善保护

Dir.description_en: The object storage key. The value is the same as the top-level `FilePath`
Dir.description_zh: 对象存储 key，值与顶层 `FilePath` 相同

Host.description_en: The target URL to which the client sends the PostObject request
Host.description_zh: 客户端执行 PostObject 请求的目标 URL

Policy.description_en: The Base64-encoded PostObject upload policy. Protect this value together with the entire `PolicyInfo`
Policy.description_zh: Base64 编码的 PostObject 上传策略。应与整个 `PolicyInfo` 一并妥善保护

SecurityToken.description_en: The `x-oss-security-token` field in the PostObject form when STS credentials are used. This field may be empty when STS is not used. This field contains sensitive authorization information
SecurityToken.description_zh: 使用 STS 凭证时，作为 PostObject 表单的 `x-oss-security-token`；未使用 STS 时可能为空。该字段属于敏感授权信息

Signature.description_en: The signature field in the PostObject form. This field contains sensitive authorization information
Signature.description_zh: PostObject 表单的签名。该字段属于敏感授权信息

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, used for Tracing Analysis and troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，用于链路追踪和问题排查

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the upload policy is generated. A successful response always returns `true`. An error response is returned upon failure
Success.description_zh: 上传策略是否已成功生成。成功响应固定返回 `true`；失败时返回错误响应

TransitId.description_en: The ID of the newly created Transit record, used for subsequent queries and storage operations
TransitId.description_zh: 新建 Transit 记录 ID，供后续查询和存储使用
